{{Quote|Let the enemy do the work!|motto shouted by the Jedi aboard ''Broadside''|<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Fury">''[[Legacy of the Force: Fury]]''</ref>}}
The '''''Broadside''''' was a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] and [[Troop transport/Legends|troop transport]] used by the [[Jedi Coalition]] during the [[Battle of Centerpoint Station (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Centerpoint Station]] in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]]. They took the ''Broadside'' to connect with [[Centerpoint Station]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and Dr. Seyah went in and completed their mission. They then left on the ''Broadside'' once again.

*''[[Legacy of the Force: Fury]]'' {{1st}}
